#!/bin/bash

# Script to start a local development server for the Harness landing page

# Change to the directory where this script is located
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

# Check if Python is available
if command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Starting server with Python 3..."
    echo "Server will be available at: http://localhost:8000"
    echo "Press Ctrl+C to stop the server"
    echo ""
    python3 -m http.server 8000
elif command -v python &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Starting server with Python..."
    echo "Server will be available at: http://localhost:8000"
    echo "Press Ctrl+C to stop the server"
    echo ""
    python -m http.server 8000
else
    echo "Error: Python is not available. Please install Python to run the server."
    exit 1
fi

arguments.newText: # Harness Landing Page A modern, responsive landing page for your software harness with a dark theme optimized for developer focus. ## Files - `index.html` - Main HTML structure - `style.css` - Dark theme styling and responsive design - `script.js` - Interactive features (smooth scrolling, mobile menu) - `start-server.sh` - Script to start a local development server - `README.md` - This documentation ## Quick Start ### Option 1: Open HTML file directly Simply open `index.html` in your web browser (though some features may not work perfectly due to file:// protocol restrictions). ### Option 2: Use the development server (Recommended) Run the startup script to serve the page locally: ```bash ./start-server.sh ``` Then visit: http://localhost:8000 ## Features - Modern dark theme design (inspired by efficient developer tools) - Fully responsive layout - Smooth scrolling navigation - Interactive hover effects - Mobile-friendly menu - Sections for features, download, and about - Download buttons for Windows, macOS, and Linux - Efficient, focused design philosophy (minimalist core with powerful capabilities) ## Design Philosophy Following the efficiency principles observed in the pi coding agent codebase: - **Minimalist Core**: Clean, focused interface without unnecessary elements - **Extensible Design**: Easy to modify and extend for specific needs - **Performance Conscious**: Optimized for fast loading and smooth interactions - **Developer-Focused**: Dark theme reduces eye strain during extended use ## Customization To change the download links, edit the `href` attributes in the download section of `index.html`: ```html Download for Windows ``` Replace `#` with your actual download URLs. ## Technologies Used - HTML5 - CSS3 (with Flexbox and Grid, dark theme optimized) - Vanilla JavaScript - Responsive design principles ## Browser Support Works in all modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
